stories.headline: RSIHub open-source framework compares AI agent evolution methods
stories.summary: Researchers have released RSIHub, an open-source framework that provides shared infrastructure to build and test methods improving AI agents through feedback. Evaluations show the tool helps compare different evolution strategies and achieves up to a 13.5 percentage point improvement in task success rates.
stories.whyItMatters: It provides a standardized platform for evaluating and improving feedback-driven AI agent evolution methods.

stories.headline: RynnUnify 16-billion parameter model combines robot control and physical reasoning
stories.summary: Alibaba DAMO Academy has introduced RynnUnify, a 16-billion parameter model that merges visual planning, physical reasoning, and robot control. The system achieves state-of-the-art results on long-horizon embodied tasks and translates physical world understanding into real robot actions.
stories.whyItMatters: It advances embodied AI by combining visual planning and physical reasoning into a single model for robotic control.

stories.headline: UserArena benchmark evaluates shopping recommendation agents using simulated users
stories.summary: Researchers have developed UserArena, a benchmark featuring over 64,000 real-world shopping session trajectories to test recommendation AI agents. The framework includes an On-Policy Trajectory Distillation method that improves simulated user behavior accuracy during long interactions.
stories.whyItMatters: It offers a realistic testing environment for evaluating and improving e-commerce shopping agents.

stories.headline: Omni-Woodpecker method reduces cross-modal hallucinations in multi-modal AI
stories.summary: A new method named Omni-Woodpecker aims to reduce cross-modal hallucinations in large language models that process audio and visual data. The approach rebalances evidence and learned priors directly within internal processing rather than just fixing final outputs.
stories.whyItMatters: It addresses multi-modal hallucinations at the architectural level to improve the reliability of audio-visual AI models.
